subtopics.title: Why One Equation Has Infinitely Many Answers

questions.question: For sin x = 0,5, the calculator's 30° is incomplete because:
options: Sine is positive in two quadrants and repeats every 360°, so there are infinitely many solutions
30° is a reference angle, which is never a solution
Sine equations always have exactly two answers

questions.question: The second solution of sin x = 0,5 in the first turn is:
Why is sin 390° also equal to 0,5?
options: Because 390° = 360° + 30°, a full turn past 30°, and sine repeats every full turn

questions.question: The reference angle of an equation like sin x = −0,6 is found from:
options: The positive value 0,6, ignoring the sign

If a substitution yields cos x = 1,3 you must:
options: Subtract 1 to bring it into range
Reject it in writing — cosine never leaves the range −1 to 1

questions.question: In the taxi picture, the integer k in a general solution counts:
options: How many full loops you fast-forward or rewind from one sighting
The size of the reference angle

questions.question: Tangent's loop is only 180° because:
options: Tangent is negative in two quadrants
Half a turn flips the sign of both shares, top and bottom, leaving the fraction unchanged

questions.question: The calculator's single answer to a trig equation is like:
options: One sighting of the taxi — the timetable still has to be written

questions.question: The big wheel passes the same height twice per turn because:
options: The wheel speeds up on the way down
It crosses that height once going up and once coming down
Sine and cosine are different functions

questions.question: Cosine's general solution compresses to ±α + k·360° because its two doors:
options: Do not exist for negative values
Sit symmetrically at the positive angle and its negative twin

questions.question: For sin x = 1, the general solution has only one family because:
options: At the peak of the wheel the way up and the way down meet — the two doors become one
One is always a special number
The calculator only gives one answer

questions.question: For sin x = −0,6, the size of the angle comes from the calculator and the placing comes from:
options: The wheel — third and fourth quarters, where the seat is below the axle

subtopics.title: Harvesting the Stretch You Were Given

questions.question: To collect solutions inside an interval, you:
options: Solve the equation again for each quadrant
Substitute small integer values of k into each family and keep results inside the interval
Divide the interval by the period

questions.question: Sine crosses a middle height like 0,5 twice per loop; over [−360°; 360°] you should expect:
The nickname move turns 2sin²x − sin x − 1 = 0 into:
options: 2s² − s − 1 = 0, an ordinary quadratic in s

questions.question: Why can sin x never equal 2?
options: Because the seat on the wheel cannot be further from the axle than the wheel is wide — sine stays between −1 and 1
Because the reference angle of 2 is too big
